events.name: Pokémon Heist
events.intro: A grey van is backed up to the Pokémon Center's side door with its engine running. Poké Balls go in by the crateful, and every Ball rattles. Grunt Hux: "Load 'em up. Strongest first." If nobody stops it: Every Center in the region will have fewer Pokémon to trade, and your rival will be robbed too.

success.text: Two Rocket Grunts get between you and the work, and behind them Grunt Hux is already reaching for a Ball.
Your Dark-type slips along the kerb, lifts the keys off Hux's belt and leaves a house key in their place. The van never starts. By the time they notice, the nurse has the crates back inside.

You leave them to it. It isn't your fight, you tell yourself, and you very nearly believe it by the time you reach the road. Every Center in the region will have fewer Pokémon to trade, and your rival will be robbed too.

remembers.notice: With Executive Archer under arrest, half the guards never turned up.

success.text: One Rocket Grunt and Grunt Hux. That's all that's left of the guard.

events.name: Black Market
events.intro: Under a railway arch, a trestle table and a row of cages with blankets over them. Nobody here uses a name. One of the blankets is shaking. Silk, the dealer: "No papers, no questions." If nobody stops it: Pokémon with no papers will turn up wild all over the region, afraid of Balls.

success.text: Two Rocket Grunts get between you and the work, and behind them Silk, the dealer is already reaching for a Ball.

choices.label: Buy every Pokémon and free them. (₽3,000)

success.text: You count it out on the table. Silk doesn't blink. You open every cage yourself, one by one, and stand there until the last of them has run.

You leave them to it. It isn't your fight, you tell yourself, and you very nearly believe it by the time you reach the road. Pokémon with no papers will turn up wild all over the region, afraid of Balls.

remembers.notice: With Executive Archer under arrest, half the guards never turned up.

success.text: One Rocket Grunt and Silk, the dealer. That's all that's left of the guard.

events.name: Radio Tower
events.intro: The tower's doors are chained from the inside. Every radio in town has gone to the same voice, calm and friendly and wrong. Executive Petrel, disguised: "This is your new broadcast." If nobody stops it: The signal will force evolutions: wild Pokémon in the region will be evolved, higher level and angry.

success.text: Two Rocket Grunts get between you and the work, and behind them Executive Petrel, disguised is already reaching for a Ball.
Your Electric-type bites through the feed cable at the base of the mast. The spark throws you both across the yard. The voice stops in the middle of a word.

You leave them to it. It isn't your fight, you tell yourself, and you very nearly believe it by the time you reach the road. The signal will force evolutions: wild Pokémon in the region will be evolved, higher level and angry.

remembers.notice: With Executive Archer under arrest, half the guards never turned up.

success.text: One Rocket Grunt and Executive Petrel, disguised. That's all that's left of the guard.

events.name: Evolution Signal
events.intro: A dish on a truck points at the hills. Around it the grass is full of small Pokémon, shaking, walking toward the hum because they can't help it. A Rocket Scientist: "It's a kindness, really. Faster." If nobody stops it: Pokémon forced to evolve in this region will be hurting: 10% lower in every stat.

success.text: Two Rocket Grunts come at you first. Behind them, unhurried, an Admin who has been waiting for exactly this.

choices.label: Comfort the wild Pokémon so they don't run into the signal.

success.text: You sit down in the grass between them and the truck and you stay there, talking low, until the shaking stops. With nothing to work on, the dish is packed away before dark.

You leave them to it. It isn't your fight, you tell yourself, and you very nearly believe it by the time you reach the road. Pokémon forced to evolve in this region will be hurting: 10% lower in every stat.

remembers.notice: With Executive Archer under arrest, half the guards never turned up.

success.text: One Rocket Grunt and A Rocket Scientist. That's all that's left of the guard.

remembers.notice: Just as you were warned: an Admin is waiting here, out of sight behind the others.

events.name: Coastal Dig
events.intro: Shovels and a pump on the beach. The trench already cuts the sand in two, and it runs straight through a ring of little flags somebody put up around the nests. An Aqua Grunt: "Dig! The sea wants this beach back." If nobody stops it: The beach will flood, and a nesting species will be gone from the region.

success.text: Two Aqua Grunts get between you and the work, and behind them An Aqua Grunt is already reaching for a Ball.
Your Water-type carries the eggs up the beach one mouthful at a time, so gently you hold your breath. With nothing left to drown, the Grunts lose heart and the pump is switched off.
You leave them to it. It isn't your fight, you tell yourself, and you very nearly believe it by the time you reach the road. The beach will flood, and a nesting species will be gone from the region.

remembers.notice: With Admin Shelly under arrest, half the guards never turned up.

success.text: One Aqua Grunt and An Aqua Grunt. That's all that's left of the guard.

events.name: Submarine Theft
events.intro: A research submarine sits in dry dock with its hatch open. Its crew are sitting on the quay with their hands on their heads. Admin Shelly: "Nice sub. Ours now." If nobody stops it: The deep trench will be open to Aqua, and Kyogre's Sign will be harder to earn (one more needed).

success.text: Two Aqua Grunts get between you and the work, and behind them Admin Shelly is already reaching for a Ball.
You wait for the gap between two patrols, drop through the hatch and spin the wheel shut behind you. The crew's spare key is where they said. Aqua hammers on the hull for an hour and goes home.

failure.text: Your foot finds the one loose plate on the gangway. Every head on the quay turns. There's no talking your way out of it now.

success.text: You leave them to it. It isn't your fight, you tell yourself, and you very nearly believe it by the time you reach the road. The deep trench will be open to Aqua, and Kyogre's Sign will be harder to earn (one more needed).

remembers.notice: With Admin Shelly under arrest, half the guards never turned up.

success.text: One Aqua Grunt and Admin Shelly. That's all that's left of the guard.

events.name: Deep-Sea Study
events.intro: A survey boat rocks over very deep water, lights pointed straight down. Everyone on deck is looking at one screen and nobody is talking. An Aqua Diver: "There. The giant. It's breathing." If nobody stops it: Aqua will know where Kyogre sleeps: at the Hideout it will be half awake.

success.text: Two Aqua Grunts get between you and the work, and behind them An Aqua Diver is already reaching for a Ball.
Your Ground-type goes over the side and churns the shelf until the sea is the colour of tea. The screen shows nothing but silt. They mark the wrong place on the chart and you let them.
You leave them to it. It isn't your fight, you tell yourself, and you very nearly believe it by the time you reach the road. Aqua will know where Kyogre sleeps: at the Hideout it will be half awake.

remembers.notice: With Admin Shelly under arrest, half the guards never turned up.

success.text: One Aqua Grunt and An Aqua Diver. That's all that's left of the guard.

events.name: Harbour Control
events.intro: A chain across the harbour mouth, and a rowboat with a cash tin tied in the middle of it. The ferry queue goes back past the fish market. Grunt Toll: "Five hundred to pass. Sea's tax." If nobody stops it: Ferries will cost ₽500 for the region, and sea nodes will be guarded.

success.text: Two Aqua Grunts come at you first. Behind them, unhurried, an Admin who has been waiting for exactly this.
You put the whole queue's fare in the tin. Toll counts it twice, lowers the chain and can't think of a reason to put it back. An old woman on the ferry rail waves at you until you're out of sight.
You leave them to it. It isn't your fight, you tell yourself, and you very nearly believe it by the time you reach the road. Ferries will cost ₽500 for the region, and sea nodes will be guarded.

remembers.notice: With Admin Shelly under arrest, half the guards never turned up.

success.text: One Aqua Grunt and Grunt Toll. That's all that's left of the guard.

remembers.notice: Just as you were warned: an Admin is waiting here, out of sight behind the others.

events.name: Volcano Drill
events.intro: A drill rig the size of a house is bolted to the crater wall. Each turn of the bit shakes small stones down the slope. Admin Courtney: "Analysing. Drilling. Drilling." If nobody stops it: There will be fire hazards on every node in the region.

success.text: Two Magma Grunts get between you and the work, and behind them Admin Courtney is already reaching for a Ball.
Your Water-type empties itself down the shaft. Steam goes up like a geyser, the bit seizes with a scream of metal, and Courtney stands in the fog writing it all down.
You leave them to it. It isn't your fight, you tell yourself, and you very nearly believe it by the time you reach the road. There will be fire hazards on every node in the region.

remembers.notice: With Admin Tabitha under arrest, half the guards never turned up.

success.text: One Magma Grunt and Admin Courtney. That's all that's left of the guard.

events.name: Meteorite Heist
events.intro: The museum's side door is off its hinges. Inside, a glass case is open and a Grunt is lifting out a rock that glows faintly, as if it's still falling. A Magma Grunt: "Space rock. Boss wants it." If nobody stops it: Magma will be able to wake Groudon early: the Hideout's last battle will be harder.

success.text: Two Magma Grunts get between you and the work, and behind them A Magma Grunt is already reaching for a Ball.

choices.label: Swap it for a plain rock.

success.text: While he signs the wrong line of his own checklist, you trade the stone in his bag for one from the garden. He carries a paving stone up a volcano. You carry the real one back to its case.

choices.label: Swap it for your own Meteorite.

success.text: You hold yours beside it. Same glow. He takes the one you hand him without looking, and the museum's stone goes back under glass before the curator wakes.

You leave them to it. It isn't your fight, you tell yourself, and you very nearly believe it by the time you reach the road. Magma will be able to wake Groudon early: the Hideout's last battle will be harder.

remembers.notice: With Admin Tabitha under arrest, half the guards never turned up.

success.text: One Magma Grunt and A Magma Grunt. That's all that's left of the guard.

events.name: Magma Survey
events.intro: Microphones on stakes are pushed into the hot ground in a ring. A woman in a hood kneels in the middle with headphones on and her eyes shut. A Magma Geologist: "Hear that? Under everything. A heartbeat." If nobody stops it: If the ground is already shaking in this region, the quakes will get worse.

success.text: Two Magma Grunts get between you and the work, and behind them A Magma Geologist is already reaching for a Ball.
Your Pokémon sings, or roars, or just will not stop. Every needle slams to the top and stays. She pulls the headphones off, furious, with nothing on the tape but you.

You leave them to it. It isn't your fight, you tell yourself, and you very nearly believe it by the time you reach the road. If the ground is already shaking in this region, the quakes will get worse.

remembers.notice: With Admin Tabitha under arrest, half the guards never turned up.

success.text: One Magma Grunt and A Magma Geologist. That's all that's left of the guard.

events.name: Hot Spring Closure
events.intro: A new fence runs right round the hot spring. Old people in towels stand outside it with their baskets, not sure what to do. A Magma Grunt: "Private land. Magma land." If nobody stops it: There will be no hot-spring rests in this region.

success.text: Two Magma Grunts come at you first. Behind them, unhurried, an Admin who has been waiting for exactly this.
Your Fighting-type takes the fence out post by post. The old people cheer and walk straight past the Grunt. A Ranger writes your name down for the damage, not unkindly.
You leave them to it. It isn't your fight, you tell yourself, and you very nearly believe it by the time you reach the road. There will be no hot-spring rests in this region.

remembers.notice: With Admin Tabitha under arrest, half the guards never turned up.

success.text: One Magma Grunt and A Magma Grunt. That's all that's left of the guard.

remembers.notice: Just as you were warned: an Admin is waiting here, out of sight behind the others.

events.name: Lake Raid
events.intro: Grey crates are stacked on the lake shore, wired together. The water is perfectly still. Out in the middle, on the island, something small is watching. Commander Saturn: "The bombs are precise. The guardian will feel almost nothing." If nobody stops it: The lake guardian will be taken, and its Sign will be lost for this run.

success.text: Two Galactic Grunts get between you and the work, and behind them Commander Saturn is already reaching for a Ball.
Your Psychic-type closes its eyes and the timers stop, one after another, with a click you feel in your teeth. Saturn looks at the dead clocks, then at you, and orders the crates loaded back up.
You leave them to it. It isn't your fight, you tell yourself, and you very nearly believe it by the time you reach the road. The lake guardian will be taken, and its Sign will be lost for this run.

remembers.notice: With Commander Mars under arrest, half the guards never turned up.

success.text: One Galactic Grunt and Commander Saturn. That's all that's left of the guard.

events.name: Energy Plant
events.intro: The power plant's gate is open and its guard is asleep at his desk, or made to be. One by one the town's windows are going dark. Commander Jupiter: "Lights out. Lovely, isn't it?" If nobody stops it: The blackout will start badly in this region (Severity 2).

success.text: Two Galactic Grunts get between you and the work, and behind them Commander Jupiter is already reaching for a Ball.

choices.label: Restart it from the backup room.

success.text: Your Electric-type puts everything it has into the backup bus. The turbines catch. Across the valley the streetlights come back in a wave, and Jupiter sighs like someone whose evening has been spoiled.
You leave them to it. It isn't your fight, you tell yourself, and you very nearly believe it by the time you reach the road. The blackout will start badly in this region (Severity 2).

remembers.notice: With Commander Mars under arrest, half the guards never turned up.

success.text: One Galactic Grunt and Commander Jupiter. That's all that's left of the guard.

events.name: Spirit Lab
events.intro: Behind a door marked STORES there is a row of glass tubes. In each one a Pokémon floats, awake, with wires on its head. They all look at you at once. Scientist Charon: "Spirit is just energy. We're harvesting." If nobody stops it: When those Pokémon are freed later they will be listless (Bond will not grow as far).

success.text: Two Galactic Grunts get between you and the work, and behind them Scientist Charon is already reaching for a Ball.

choices.label: Free the Pokémon through the vents.

success.text: You open the tubes from the service side and pass them up into the duct, one warm shaking body at a time. The last one licks your hand before it goes. Charon is still talking to an empty room.

failure.text: A tube alarm chirps. Charon turns round with his finger still raised. There's no talking your way out of it now.

success.text: You leave them to it. It isn't your fight, you tell yourself, and you very nearly believe it by the time you reach the road. When those Pokémon are freed later they will be listless (Bond will not grow as far).

remembers.notice: With Commander Mars under arrest, half the guards never turned up.

success.text: One Galactic Grunt and Scientist Charon. That's all that's left of the guard.

events.name: Veilstone Warehouse
events.intro: A warehouse with a spiked roof. A forklift goes back and forth, loading crates of Poké Balls and old bones onto a truck with no plates. A Galactic Grunt: "Balls, fossils. Boss wants the lot." If nobody stops it: Fossils cannot be revived in this region.

success.text: Two Galactic Grunts come at you first. Behind them, unhurried, an Admin who has been waiting for exactly this.

choices.label: Re-label the crates for the Museum.

success.text: A pot of paste, a stack of the Museum's own labels, and an hour of careful work. The truck drives off pleased with itself and delivers everything to the curator's back door.
You leave them to it. It isn't your fight, you tell yourself, and you very nearly believe it by the time you reach the road. Fossils cannot be revived in this region.

remembers.notice: With Commander Mars under arrest, half the guards never turned up.

success.text: One Galactic Grunt and A Galactic Grunt. That's all that's left of the guard.

remembers.notice: Just as you were warned: an Admin is waiting here, out of sight behind the others.

events.name: Liberation Rally
events.intro: A stage, a banner, a crowd that came for the free tea. A gentle old man in robes holds out both hands. People in the front row are looking down at their own Poké Balls. Sage Rood: "Free your Pokémon. Isn't that what love is?" If nobody stops it: One in five Roster trainers in this region will release their team.

success.text: Two Plasma Grunts get between you and the work, and behind them Sage Rood is already reaching for a Ball.
You climb the steps. Rood, to his credit, hands you the microphone.
You leave them to it. It isn't your fight, you tell yourself, and you very nearly believe it by the time you reach the road. One in five Roster trainers in this region will release their team.

remembers.notice: With Sage Zinzolin under arrest, half the guards never turned up.

success.text: One Plasma Grunt and Sage Rood. That's all that's left of the guard.

events.name: Your Turn at the Microphone
events.intro: The crowd goes quiet in the way crowds do when they are waiting to be told something. A girl in the front row has her Poké Ball in both hands, holding it against her chest. Sage Rood smiles at you, the kind smile of someone who has done this a hundred times.

choices.label: "Ask your Pokémon. Open the Ball and ask."

success.text: You say it, and then you take your own Ball off your belt and open it. Your Pokémon comes out, looks at the crowd, looks at you, and leans its whole weight against your leg. Nobody says anything for a while. Then the girl in the front row opens hers. One by one, all down the rows, people let their Pokémon out to see what they will do, and not one of them walks away. Rood is still smiling, but nobody is looking at him any more.

It's true, and it doesn't matter. "Who are you to say?" someone shouts, and the crowd turns its back on you. Rood's helpers take you by the elbows, very gently, off the stage and into an alley full of Plasma Grunts.

choices.label: "Pokémon are happier with us. Everybody knows that."

success.text: "Everybody knows it, do they?" Rood asks, mild as milk, and the crowd laughs, at you, not with you. While they're laughing, his helpers walk you off the stage and round the back, where the Plasma Grunts are waiting.

events.name: Pokémon Confiscation
events.intro: A checkpoint on the road into town. The man running it wears a ranger's coat that doesn't fit and has a crate of other people's Poké Balls behind him. A Plasma Grunt in a fake ranger coat: "For their safety." If nobody stops it: One of your party will be confiscated at the next town unless you fight for it. It is returned at the Hideout.

success.text: Two Plasma Grunts get between you and the work, and behind them A Plasma Grunt in a fake ranger coat is already reaching for a Ball.

battle.name: A Plasma Grunt in a fake ranger coat

success.text: You make the call. Twenty minutes later three real Rangers walk up the road, look at his coat, look at him, and hold out a hand for the crate. He gives it to them.

You leave them to it. It isn't your fight, you tell yourself, and you very nearly believe it by the time you reach the road. One of your party will be confiscated at the next town unless you fight for it. It is returned at the Hideout.

remembers.notice: With Sage Zinzolin under arrest, half the guards never turned up.

success.text: One Plasma Grunt and A Plasma Grunt in a fake ranger coat. That's all that's left of the guard.

battle.name: A Plasma Grunt in a fake ranger coat

events.name: Frigate Build
events.intro: A ship on a slipway with a cannon where the mast should be. Frost creeps down the hull and across the dockyard stones while you watch. A Plasma Grunt: "Ice cannon's nearly ready." If nobody stops it: It will hail on every node in this region.

success.text: Two Plasma Grunts get between you and the work, and behind them A Plasma Grunt is already reaching for a Ball.
Your Fire-type climbs the barrel and breathes into the cooling coils until they glow and sag. The first test shot is a puff of warm steam. The shipwrights laugh. The Grunt doesn't.
You leave them to it. It isn't your fight, you tell yourself, and you very nearly believe it by the time you reach the road. It will hail on every node in this region.

remembers.notice: With Sage Zinzolin under arrest, half the guards never turned up.

success.text: One Plasma Grunt and A Plasma Grunt. That's all that's left of the guard.

events.name: Genesect Project
events.intro: A clean room behind three doors. On the table, a Pokémon of purple metal with a cannon bolted to its back. Its eyes follow whoever is talking. Colress: "Fascinating, isn't it? A Pokémon rebuilt. Improved." If nobody stops it: A hostile Genesect will appear as a boss later in the region.

success.text: Two Plasma Grunts come at you first. Behind them, unhurried, an Admin who has been waiting for exactly this.
You say the thing you learned to say. The red eyes dim to something softer. It climbs off the table by itself and stands behind you. Colress makes a note and, for once, doesn't try to stop anything.
You leave them to it. It isn't your fight, you tell yourself, and you very nearly believe it by the time you reach the road. A hostile Genesect will appear as a boss later in the region.

remembers.notice: With Sage Zinzolin under arrest, half the guards never turned up.

success.text: One Plasma Grunt and Colress. That's all that's left of the guard.

remembers.notice: Just as you were warned: an Admin is waiting here, out of sight behind the others.

events.name: Power Plant
events.intro: Red suits on the power plant roof, and thick cables running off toward the hills instead of the town. Down in the streets every café has gone to candles. A Flare Grunt: "Fashionable outage!" If nobody stops it: The blackout will start in this region (Severity 1).

success.text: Two Flare Grunts get between you and the work, and behind them A Flare Grunt is already reaching for a Ball.

choices.label: Reroute the power to the town.

success.text: Your Electric-type takes the load on its own body for the three seconds it takes you to throw the switch back. The town lights up. The cable to the hills goes cold.
You leave them to it. It isn't your fight, you tell yourself, and you very nearly believe it by the time you reach the road. The blackout will start in this region (Severity 1).

remembers.notice: With Admin Celosia under arrest, half the guards never turned up.

success.text: One Flare Grunt and A Flare Grunt. That's all that's left of the guard.

events.name: Stone Mining
events.intro: Red uniforms on a hillside. A seam of stone glows under their drills. Down the valley a Pokémon screams, and a farmer comes running: his Ampharos went Mega in the field, all by itself, and can't come back. In the seam chamber a woman is waiting. Her Mega Manectric has been Mega for three days, and its fur is falling out. Admin Celosia: "Do you know what a Mega Stone is? It's a Pokémon's future, frozen. We're just thawing them early." If nobody stops it: The mine will keep running: after three stages your Mega-capable Pokémon will flicker in battle.

choices.label: Return the stones to the ground.

success.text: "Then make me," Celosia says, and her Manectric's mane crackles.
"So you want them too," Celosia says. "Of course you do."
You open the sluice above the workings. Nobody is hurt and nothing is saved. The glow goes out under brown water, and the seam is gone for good.

You leave them to it. It isn't your fight, you tell yourself, and you very nearly believe it by the time you reach the road. The mine will keep running: after three stages your Mega-capable Pokémon will flicker in battle.

remembers.notice: Celosia: "You took one. You're no different."

addChoices.label: Give the stone back, then return them all.

success.text: You hold out the stone they paid you with. Celosia looks at it for a long moment before she reaches for her Ball.

events.name: Ultimate Weapon
events.intro: Under the town, a hall of glass tubes. A Pokémon stands in each one with a cable at its back, and all the cables run to one machine. The grass on the hill above has gone grey. Scientist Xerosic: "It drains life. Elegantly." If nobody stops it: The land will be drained: every rest in this region heals 10% less.

success.text: Two Flare Grunts get between you and the work, and behind them Scientist Xerosic is already reaching for a Ball.
You pull the coupling with both hands. The tubes open with a sigh. They come out slowly, blinking, and the strongest of them carries the weakest up the stairs.
You leave them to it. It isn't your fight, you tell yourself, and you very nearly believe it by the time you reach the road. The land will be drained: every rest in this region heals 10% less.

remembers.notice: With Admin Celosia under arrest, half the guards never turned up.

success.text: One Flare Grunt and Scientist Xerosic. That's all that's left of the guard.

events.name: Flare Tickets
events.intro: A velvet rope, a gold table, and a queue of people in their best coats holding bank drafts. The sign says ADMISSION TO THE FUTURE. The ticket seller: "Five million. The future's exclusive." If nobody stops it: The rich of the region will leave, and shop prices will rise 10%.

success.text: Two Flare Grunts come at you first. Behind them, unhurried, an Admin who has been waiting for exactly this.

choices.label: Show the queue the tickets are worthless.

success.text: You read the small print aloud: no date, no place, no refund. A man at the front asks one question the seller can't answer. Then everyone is asking. The rope comes down by itself.
You leave them to it. It isn't your fight, you tell yourself, and you very nearly believe it by the time you reach the road. The rich of the region will leave, and shop prices will rise 10%.

remembers.notice: With Admin Celosia under arrest, half the guards never turned up.

success.text: One Flare Grunt and The ticket seller. That's all that's left of the guard.

remembers.notice: Just as you were warned: an Admin is waiting here, out of sight behind the others.

events.name: Pokémon Snatch
events.intro: Two Grunts are trying to get over the daycare fence and making a lot of noise about it. On the other side the little ones have stopped playing to watch. A Skull Grunt: "Daycare's got the good ones, yo." If nobody stops it: The daycare will be closed for the region.

success.text: Two Skull Grunts get between you and the work, and behind them A Skull Grunt is already reaching for a Ball.
The daycare lady has done this before. Between you, every one of them is under a bed, in a laundry basket or up the chimney by the time the Grunts get over. They find a very clean, very empty garden.
You leave them to it. It isn't your fight, you tell yourself, and you very nearly believe it by the time you reach the road. The daycare will be closed for the region.

remembers.notice: With Admin Plumeria under arrest, half the guards never turned up.

success.text: One Skull Grunt and A Skull Grunt. That's all that's left of the guard.

events.name: Trial Crash
events.intro: The trial site's gate is hung with skull flags. Four Grunts stand on the captain's own stage with a speaker, rapping. It is not going well and they will not stop. Skull Grunts, rapping badly: "Yo, yo, trial's closed, yo, 'cause we said so, yo..." If nobody stops it: That Island Trial will be unavailable for this run.

success.text: Two Skull Grunts get between you and the work, and behind them Skull Grunts, rapping badly is already reaching for a Ball.
You find the beat they kept losing and you stay on it. By the second verse their own speaker guy is nodding. They leave the stage with dignity, which is more than they came with.

failure.text: You lose the beat on the third bar. They notice. They are delighted. There's no talking your way out of it now.

success.text: You leave them to it. It isn't your fight, you tell yourself, and you very nearly believe it by the time you reach the road. That Island Trial will be unavailable for this run.

remembers.notice: With Admin Plumeria under arrest, half the guards never turned up.

success.text: One Skull Grunt and Skull Grunts, rapping badly. That's all that's left of the guard.

events.name: Town Takeover
events.intro: A barricade of shopping trolleys across the town's one road. A Grunt sits on top of it in a deck chair with a bucket for the money. Grunt Gate: "Fee to pass. It's Po Town rules." If nobody stops it: That town's rest will be run by Skull (it heals 50%).

success.text: Two Skull Grunts get between you and the work, and behind them Grunt Gate is already reaching for a Ball.
You drop it in the bucket. Gate looks in, surprised anyone ever did, and waves the whole street through behind you because he has lost count.
Through a garden, over a wall, along a roof. An old man watering his plants holds the ladder for you without a word. You open the barricade from the town side.

failure.text: A roof tile slides off under your foot and lands in Gate's bucket. There's no talking your way out of it now.

success.text: You leave them to it. It isn't your fight, you tell yourself, and you very nearly believe it by the time you reach the road. That town's rest will be run by Skull (it heals 50%).

remembers.notice: With Admin Plumeria under arrest, half the guards never turned up.

success.text: One Skull Grunt and Grunt Gate. That's all that's left of the guard.

events.name: Skull Recruit
events.intro: A folding table outside the Pokémon Center with a box of black caps on it. Three kids with trial amulets in their fists are standing in front of it, not looking at each other. The recruiter: "Failed your trial? We don't care. Join." If nobody stops it: Every ambush in this region will have three more Skull Grunts.

success.text: Two Skull Grunts come at you first. Behind them, unhurried, an Admin who has been waiting for exactly this.
You ask the smallest one how far she got. Further than she thinks. You tell her so. She puts the cap back in the box and walks off toward the trial site, and after a moment the other two follow.
You leave them to it. It isn't your fight, you tell yourself, and you very nearly believe it by the time you reach the road. Every ambush in this region will have three more Skull Grunts.

remembers.notice: With Admin Plumeria under arrest, half the guards never turned up.

events.name: Pylon Strike
events.intro: Five pylons march across the valley, and there is a green scarf at the foot of every one. The line on the far left runs to the hospital on the hill. A saboteur: "Cut the lines. The mine dies in the dark." If nobody stops it: The blackout will start badly in this region (Severity 2).

success.text: Two Accord Saboteurs get between you and the work, and behind them A saboteur is already reaching for a Ball.
You can't be at five pylons. You stand under the one that matters and you don't move. The other four go down in the night, one by one. On the hill the hospital windows stay lit.
You leave them to it. It isn't your fight, you tell yourself, and you very nearly believe it by the time you reach the road. The blackout will start badly in this region (Severity 2).

events.name: Pipeline Sabotage
events.intro: Along the pipeline small fires are burning in a neat row, each under a valve. The wind is getting up. One of the fire-setters is looking at the dry grass and biting his lip. A saboteur: "Small fires. Small, I said." If nobody stops it: Wildfire will start in this region.

success.text: Two Accord Saboteurs get between you and the work, and behind them A saboteur is already reaching for a Ball.
Your Water-type goes down the line dousing each one while you stamp out what creeps into the grass. The saboteur who was biting his lip picks up a bucket and helps you, and doesn't say anything.
You leave them to it. It isn't your fight, you tell yourself, and you very nearly believe it by the time you reach the road. Wildfire will start in this region.

events.name: Wild Release
events.intro: Every gate on the ranch stands open. Mareep, Tauros and a hundred frightened Pidgey pour onto the road, and the ranch dogs don't know which way to run. An Accord member: "Free them all! Every ranch!" If nobody stops it: Routes will flood with displaced Pokémon: twice the wild encounters, all of them scared.

choices.label: Help the ranchers round them up.

success.text: It takes all afternoon and every Pokémon you have. The last Mareep comes in riding on your lead's back. The rancher's daughter counts heads twice and bursts into tears when the number is right.

You leave them to it. It isn't your fight, you tell yourself, and you very nearly believe it by the time you reach the road. Routes will flood with displaced Pokémon: twice the wild encounters, all of them scared.

events.name: Manifesto Drive
events.intro: Every wall in town has the same poster on it, still wet. A girl with a paste bucket is doing the last lamp post. People read it on the way to work and walk a little slower after. The paster: "Read it. You'll agree." If nobody stops it: Townsfolk will side with the Accord, and the Rangers will think less of you.

success.text: Two Accord Saboteurs come at you first. Behind them, unhurried, an Admin who has been waiting for exactly this.

choices.label: Read it, and write a reply under it.

success.text: You read it all. Some of it is true. You write underneath what the hospital needs and what happens to a ward in the dark, and you sign your name. By evening the town has read both. The paster reads yours last, twice.

You leave them to it. It isn't your fight, you tell yourself, and you very nearly believe it by the time you reach the road. Townsfolk will side with the Accord, and the Rangers will think less of you.

events.intro: A referee stands by the players' tunnel turning an unopened envelope over and over in his hands. He jumps when he sees you. The referee, nervous: "Close calls go to the Circle." If nobody stops it: Close battles will go against you (ties lose).

He won't say it for nothing: he has a mortgage. You cover the envelope out of your own pocket. He gives you a name, a locker number and the envelope itself, still sealed, and blows his whistle straight for the rest of the season.

success.text: You say Piers Dunne's name. The referee knew his father. He hands you the envelope, sealed, and the locker number, and asks you to tell Piers he's sorry it took him this long.

events.name: A Hostile Genesect
events.intro: The road ahead is scorched in two straight lines. At the end of them a Genesect of purple metal stands perfectly still, its cannon tracking you. Somebody taught it that you were the enemy, and it believed them.

success.text: It doesn't wait for you to be ready.

choices.label: Get your team out of its way.

success.text: You pull everyone back behind a wall and let it pass. It will find you again before long.
